lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is the Carhenge redevelopment, which lands in two separate hearings on September 30 — a special HARC session reviewing preliminary architecture for all five proposed buildings at 700 W. Pacific Ave, and a special Town Council session to hear the appeal of P&Z's lot-consolidation approval. That subdivision question has to be settled before anything else can move, so Tuesday's council hearing is the one to watch. The Gondola Leadership Committee also meets Sunday to weigh federal funding versus local control on the gondola project — a choice with long consequences either way.

notable.stake: Council chooses federal strings vs. local control for gondola financing.
